rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a portrait, likeness, or portraits considered as a group.

example.english: The portraiture in the exhibition captures each person’s likeness, showing how observant the painter is.
example.traditional: 展覽入面啲人像各有各似，睇得出畫家觀察入微。
example.jyutping: zin2 laam5 jap6 min6 di1 jan4 zoeng6 gok3 jau5 gok3 ci5 tai2 dak1 ceot1 waa2 gaa1 gun1 caat3 jap6 mei4

rows.note: Use this for the painting side of portraiture, rather than for portrait photography.

example.english: Portraiture of the elderly is his specialty.
example.traditional: 佢專畫老人家嘅人像畫。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zyun1 waa2 lou5 jan4 gaa1 ge3 jan4 zoeng6 waak6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the photographic side of portraiture.

example.english: I want to learn portraiture so I can take lovely photos of my family.
example.traditional: 我想學人像攝影，幫屋企人影靚相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 hok6 jan4 zoeng6 sip3 jing2 bong1 uk1 kei2 jan4 jing2 leng3 soeng2
